references.text: Here it is shown that God has the power to forgive sins, which reflects Jesus' claim of his own authority to forgive sins on earth.
This verse speaks of God's forgiveness of all your sins, corresponding with Jesus' actions and words in Mark 2:10.
Micah proclaims that there is no one like God, who forgives sins, which underscores Jesus' divine nature and authority in Mark 2:10.
This is a parallel event where Jesus heals a paralyzed man and declares that He has the power to forgive sins on earth, directly related to the event and statement in Mark 2:10.
Luke gives a similar account as Mark, where Jesus confirms his authority to forgive sins on earth through a healing.
